~ WHY YOU WILL LOVE “BLUE PEACH” ~
• 6-seat gas golf cart included
• Community heated and chilled pool
• 4 bicycles provided by owner
• 6 backpack beach chairs, 1 wagon and 1 umbrella for guest use
• Outdoor shower and multiple outdoor living spaces
• Located in the gated Lakeside community at Blue Mountain Beach
• Connected walkway to The Shops at Redfish Village
• Short bike ride to the beach | Walkable in under 15 minutes
• Just 4 miles to Seaside & WaterColor via a beautiful paved bike path
• Only 100 yards to Blue Mountain Creamery (local favorite!)

~ THE SPACE ~
Welcome to “Blue Peach,” an elegant coastal cottage offering four bedrooms, three and a half bathrooms, and accommodations for up to ten guests, located in the gated community of Lakeside at Blue Mountain Beach. This thoughtfully designed home blends relaxed beach living with upscale finishes, showcasing a soothing palette of coastal blues and soft neutrals throughout.

The main level features a bright open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area highlighted by crisp white shiplap, high ceilings with coffered beams, and carefully curated coastal décor. The living area offers two leather sofas, club chairs, and a large wall-mounted Smart TV, creating a comfortable space to gather after a day at the beach. The dining area seats six to seven guests, with additional seating for three at the kitchen bar.

The gourmet kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, a KitchenAid gas range and dishwasher, French-door refrigerator, and natural quartzite stone countertops, making it ideal for family meals or entertaining. A conveniently located half bath is tucked just past the stairway on the main floor.

All four bedrooms are located on the second floor, offering privacy and a quiet retreat. The spacious primary king suiteincludes access to the second-floor balcony and a luxurious en-suite bathroom featuring a Taj Mahal quartzite vanity with dual sinks, capiz seashell lighting, a garden soaking tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower. The adjacent guest king suite includes its own private bathroom with a tub/shower combination.

Down the hall, the queen guest bedroom is filled with natural light and shares a Jack-and-Jill bathroom featuring a specialty quartzite dual-sink vanity, capiz lighting, and a tub/shower combination. French doors from this area open to the expansive second-floor balcony, which includes chaise lounge chairs and a charming bed swing and is shared with the primary suite. Across the corridor is a custom-built guest bedroom with two full beds, also connected to the Jack-and-Jill bathroom. A full laundry room with washer, dryer, and dehumidifier is located on the second floor. Every bedroom in “Blue Peach” is equipped with wall-mounted Smart TVs, allowing guests to log into their favorite streaming services.

Step outside to enjoy a beautifully designed outdoor space just off the back door. The patio features a dining table with seating for eight, café-style string lights on a timer, a propane grill, and four Adirondack-style chairs on the open stone patio—perfect for relaxing in the sunshine. The outdoor shower is ideal for rinsing off after a beach day or a ride on the included 6-seat gas golf cart.

* Room Details *
Master King Suite, Private Bathroom (2nd floor)
Guest King Bedroom, Private Bathroom (2nd floor)
Guest Queen Bedroom, Shared Jack-and-Jill Bathroom (2nd floor)
Guest Bedroom with Two Full Beds (Custom Built), Shared Jack-and-Jill Bathroom (2nd floor)

* Pool & Amenity Details *
6-Seat Gas Golf Cart, golf cart rental company requires a $30 incidental fee and a signed waiver after booking
4 Adult Bikes
Community Pool
• Heated: March 1 – May 1 & October 1 – January 1
• Chilled: July 1 – Labor Day

* Special Attention Rules *
On-site 24-hour HOA Manager
NO pets, smoking, parties or events
Must be 30+ to book
NO college spring break groups
Property is equipped with exterior security monitoring
Maximum 3 vehicles | Garage is for golf cart storage only
Mailbox is not for guest use

~ WHY YOU WILL LOVE THE AREA ~
Located in Blue Mountain Beach, “Blue Peach” offers easy access to some of the most beloved destinations along Scenic Highway 30A. Guests are just steps from Redfish Village, minutes from Grayton Beach State Park, and a short bike ride from pristine beaches, local restaurants, beach bars, and boutique shopping. The paved Timpoochee Trail provides a scenic route to Seaside and WaterColor, while nearby ice cream, dining, and outdoor adventures make this area a favorite for families and couples alike.

~ WHY YOU WILL LOVE RENTING FROM BEACH LUXURY VACATIONS ~
• Locally owned and operated boutique management company
• Premier Hosting Partner on world-renowned booking platforms
• Consistently top-rated for cleanliness and guest experience
• Our team lives within 20 minutes of our homes for fast, local support
• True locals with insider dining and activity recommendations
• Personalized guidance for golf carts, bikes, beach services, and local adventures
• Trusted local connections—we recommend what we use with our own families
• Attentive, hands-on hosting with a focus on long-term guest relationships
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Blue Mountain Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and on the beach. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.

reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: This home exceeded our expectations in every way. The management company was so helpful and amazing. The home was extremely clean, beautifully furnished, and very well equipped. The kitchen had everything we needed, and the outdoor spaces were great for relaxing after a day at the beach. The location is excellent and the golf cart makes beach trips effortless. We would absolutely book this property again.

reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response: Thank you for your fabulous review! We are thrilled you enjoyed the location, the community pool and the use of the included golf cart. We couldn't be happier you chose to stay with Beach Luxury Vacations and we would love to have you stay with us again.

reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our time at Blue Peach! The house was perfect for our needs and the gas golf cart was an amazing add on to take us to all the local stops. It is very close to the beach but far enough to be quiet. We visited the community pool and it was good and it being heated was a plus! This is one of the more furnished rentals we have stayed at with kitchen supplies and overall amenities. We will definitely be returning!
